**Ch 019 Draft — scan**

- "He reminded me" — "The dragon form is a great strain on the body," he reminded me." The word "reminded" implies Xander said this before in the draft. In the source Ch 019, he says "as I told you before the dragon form is a great strain on the body." In the draft of Ch 019, is there any prior mention of the dragon form being a strain? No — the map scene is compressed and the earlier conversation where this was established does not appear in Ch 019 draft. However, looking back at Ch 018 draft, is it established there? Ch 018 draft does not mention the strain of dragon form. So "he reminded me" implies a prior statement that exists nowhere in either draft chapter. A competent reader would be genuinely confused: the word "reminded" signals that something was said before, but it wasn't — this reads as a broken reference to a cut passage. This is a **dangling_reference** (the antecedent statement was cut).

- "I paused mid–curtain measurement" — The source has Miriam "stop her perusing and curtain measurements." The draft has no prior mention of curtain measurements in Ch 019; the source's context is "I looked around the room and shrugged... [then she begins looking around/measuring curtains]." In the draft, the closest prior text is "I laughed and glanced around the room. 'I mean, this isn't exactly a nice apartment, but it'll work.'" However, a competent reader can infer she was idly looking around/mentally redecorating from "this isn't exactly a nice apartment, but it'll work" — it's a reasonable inference. This is less-ornamented, not genuinely confusing. Not a finding.

- The map/geography overview is an authorized digression removal (Ch 019 — Map tour and geography overview of the five kingdoms), but the draft *kept* the map scene. The authorized cut only removes the "map tour and geography overview," and the draft retained a compressed version. Not relevant.

The draft includes "Nice in bed, too," she stage-whispered — this is retained, not cut. The authorized removal was of the stallions banter specifically. The draft omits only the stallions line. - "We stepped into the bustle, toward our waiting horses, toward the road that would lead us to his bay and his city and the rest of whatever I'd just chosen." — "his bay and his city" refers to Alexandria on the bay, which was established in the draft map scene. Parses fine.
